Keep the scenario provider-neutral and do not rely on a canonical product solution.

options.text: Enforce uniqueness or conflict detection at the authoritative write boundary. In this normal path for video transcoding, a checked read followed by an unguarded write races; the owner needs a constraint or serialization rule. The owner must also make a worker dying during a long job observable rather than silently passing it to another layer.

constraints: the search result must respect tenant and ownership boundaries
Transfer the ownership and failure rule, then re-evaluate the changed workload rather than copying a product solution.
The primary decision is enforce uniqueness or conflict detection at the authoritative write boundary..
Keep the scenario provider-neutral and do not rely on a canonical product solution.

options.text: Enforce uniqueness or conflict detection at the authoritative write boundary. In this transfer case for customer support search, a checked read followed by an unguarded write races; the owner needs a constraint or serialization rule. The owner must also make a broad query crossing a trust boundary observable rather than silently passing it to another layer.
Choose the nearest familiar component and let each caller decide uniqueness, invariants, and concurrency control independently, without a shared owner or failure contract.
Add replication, caching, retries, or asynchronous buffering immediately, even though the scenario has not shown that mechanism is the limiting constraint.
Keep the happy path and treat a broad query crossing a trust boundary as an operational exception that the caller can resolve manually.
Select a named cloud or vendor product first and infer the workload, ownership, and guarantee from that product's defaults.

feedback.Reason: Enforce uniqueness or conflict detection at the authoritative write boundary. It addresses the search result must respect tenant and ownership boundaries through an explicit mechanism and keeps a broad query crossing a trust boundary inside a visible ownership and recovery boundary.

Details.mechanismOrProperty: A checked read followed by an unguarded write races; the owner needs a constraint or serialization rule. The transfer case makes the enforcement point explicit instead of relying on a product default.
Details.scenarioApplication: For customer support search, the decision keeps the search result must respect tenant and ownership boundaries attached to the owner that can observe the state. The design treats a broad query crossing a trust boundary as a named failure path.
Details.errorCorrection: The distractors either make the boundary unowned, add unmeasured complexity, ignore recovery, or replace mechanism reasoning with provider trivia. Transfer the ownership and failure rule, then re-evaluate the changed workload rather than copying a product solution.
Details.boundaryOrTradeoff: Do not reduce “Uniqueness, invariants, and concurrency control” to terminology recall. Choose storage from access patterns and invariants, not from data labels alone; separate source-of-truth storage from derived indexes and caches. The trade-off is that explicit ownership and evidence may require a narrower contract or an operational signal, but that cost is preferable to silently violating the stated guarantee.
Details.ownership: The service or boundary that owns the relevant state and can enforce uniqueness, invariants, and concurrency control must own the decision; callers coordinate through the contract.
Details.transfer: Carry the ownership and failure rule into a new domain, then re-check the changed workload, guarantee, and recovery requirement.
Details.provenance: Technical claim anchored to PostgreSQL documentation (https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/index.html); scenario, options, and feedback are independently authored.
